integrity: Exact characteristic-free proof and independent finite checks of original multiplication; no claim that finite tests establish general geometry.
scientific_limitations: Classifies reduced geometric commuting-tuple supports for symmetric trivial extensions of Kronecker path algebras, not the nonreduced commuting schemes or simultaneous conjugacy orbits. The proof uses standard properties of symplectic isotropic Grassmannians. Priority comparisons are nonexhaustive and independent mathematical validation is outstanding.
title: A reducibility threshold for commuting tuples in symmetric Kronecker trivial extensions
